usedFor: Acuity Scheduling holds client bookings, and Zoho Books receives each client when “New Appointment Scheduled” runs “Create or Update Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment Scheduled” in Acuity Scheduling, then “Create or Update Customer” in Zoho Books
bestTemplate.why: Booking is the first moment a client exists, so the customer record is ready before the first invoice.

watchOut: “Appointment Rescheduled” also reaches “Create or Update Customer”, so one client can run through it more than once.
